Name: Jered, Father of Gedor
Summary: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Gedor.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Gedor.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jered stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
